start.old_node: keel needs Node.js {min} or newer (found {found}). Install it from https://nodejs.org; keel commands will not run until then.
context.warning: keel: context is {used} of {limit} tokens ({percent}%), auto-compact is close. Run /compact with a focus (what to keep), or save the state and start a new session.
report.head: usage report: session {id} ({project}{entry}), wallet {wallet}
report.estimated: ~ output estimated from visible text; hidden reasoning is not counted
report.subscription: subscription: dollars are list prices, they count against the plan limits

report.share_week.one: week: about {pct} % of the weekly limit (1 % = about ${rate}, {n} point)
report.share_week.other: week: about {pct} % of the weekly limit (1 % = about ${rate}, {n} points)

report.share_five_hour.one: 5-hour: about {pct} % of the 5-hour limit (1 % = about ${rate}, {n} point)
report.share_five_hour.other: 5-hour: about {pct} % of the 5-hour limit (1 % = about ${rate}, {n} points)

report.no_calibration: no calibration yet — it appears after a few sessions with the status line or desktop snapshots
report.waiting: calibration waits for the sync of: {machines}
report.wallet_api: wallet api: real money at API prices, no plan percentages
report.wallet_credit: wallet credit: paid from prepaid credit, no plan percentages
report.wallet_unknown: wallet unknown (session started without the keel hook): no plan percentages
report.unpriced: new model without a price ({models}) — run price update: /keel:configure prices
report.cross_check: cross-check: our estimate ${ours}, Claude Code's own total ${cc}
report.note.sync_off: Usage page: the sync of this PC is off since {since}. Costs are still collected here; /keel:usage on sends them all.
report.note.api: Usage page: this session uses an API key, so it cannot reach the page on claude.ai. The next session signed in with claude.ai sends these costs; nothing is lost.
report.note.no_tools: Usage page: this session has no page tools, so the sync waits. The next session that has them sends everything; nothing is lost.
report.note.name_taken: Usage page: another PC already syncs as "{pc}", so nothing was sent. Give this PC another name in /keel:configure; nothing is lost.
report.note.name_ask: Usage page: the page already has a PC named "{pc}". Nothing was sent until you say whether it is this PC (before a reinstall) or another one.
report.note.team_page: This project's shared usage page (usage.artifact_url in .keel/config.json) is no longer used: each PC syncs to its owner's own page, and Share on that page shows it to others.
calibration.head: calibration
calibration.reason.pending: waiting for a machine to sync
confirm.task_delete: keel: task {id} is done? Its folder {path} goes to keel's trash.
confirm.task_drop: keel: drop task {id}? Its folder {path} goes to keel's trash (/keel:cleanup restore brings it back).
confirm.empty_trash: keel: delete {which} of keel's trash for good? This cannot be undone.
confirm.trash_old: the batches {days} or more days old
confirm.delete_branch: keel: delete the local branch {branch}? Its commits that no other branch holds are lost.
confirm.delete_branch_remote: keel: delete the branch {branch}, local and on the remote? Its commits that no other branch holds are lost.
confirm.merge: keel: merge the task branch into {target} and push {target}?
confirm.trust: keel: let keel run its git steps (branch, commit, push) in this project on this machine without asking each time?
lane.planning: keel: this conversation plans {feature}, so /keel:{command} does not run here. Finish planning with /keel:end-planning, or start a new conversation.
lane.task: keel: this conversation works on task {id}, so /keel:{command} does not run here. Planning runs in its own conversation: finish the task with /keel:end-task, or start a new conversation.
lane.unattended: keel: planning is a conversation with a person. Run /keel:start-planning in a regular chat.
confirm.plans_commit: keel: commit the planning files in {repo}?
confirm.plans_push: keel: push the branch with the planning files of {repo} to the remote?
confirm.plans_word: keel: this plans.js command holds the word commit or push and may run that step. Run it?
page.draft_note: Draft: the tickets are not exported to the repository yet, so they have no state.
page.as_of_title: The snapshot of the md files as of these commits
page.not_on_pc_title: The {repo} repository is not on this machine, so keel cannot read this ticket's state.
page.refresh: Snapshot of {date}. To update it, run in Claude Code in this project:
page.md_note: The file as it is in git, not translated.
page.via_branch_title: The git branch the work is on
page.via_task: a keel task on this machine
page.via_session: a keel session noted on this machine
page.via_commits: commits with its key on {branch}; status not written
page.no_section: The ticket has no such section.
page.no_deps: This ticket waits for no other ticket.
page.where_yours_title: The code of {key} is already in the {branch} feature branch: {ticket} can start.
page.where_feature: ready in the {branch} feature branch, not in {into}
page.where_branch: ready in the {branch} branch, not in {into}
page.where_pull_title: To start {ticket}: wait until it is merged into {into}, or pull it into your branch {pull}: git merge {branch}
page.where_wait_title: Wait until it is merged into {into}.
page.where_local: done in the local {branch}, not pushed yet
page.where_local_title: Wait until it is pushed to the server.
page.where_ticket: ready in the {branch} ticket branch, not in the {into} feature branch yet
page.not_here: The ticket's text is in the {repo} repository, which is not on this machine.
page.on_branch_title: The ticket's file is not on this branch yet; its text comes from the {branch} branch.
page.translated: Translated; the original is in {lang}, in the md files in git.
page.footer: A snapshot of the feature's md files as of the commits above; the files in git are the source. Made by /keel:feature-page.
page.state.waiting_branch: waiting for merge into the feature branch
page.section.question: Question
page.lead.acceptance_criteria: The ticket is done when every item below holds.
page.lead.boundaries: What to do every time in this ticket, what needs a yes first, and what never to do.
page.lead.where_to_look: Where the work starts in the code, and why there.
page.lead.dependencies: The tickets that must be done before this one.
page.info.in_plain_words: The whole task in plain words, for anyone: what changes for people, how it works, what is in and what is not.
page.info.example: A short "what happens → what we see" sample.
page.info.goal: In one or two sentences: what to do and how to tell it is done.
page.info.acceptance_criteria: The behaviours the ticket must have; an action checks each one. All of them hold → the ticket is done.
page.info.how_to_check: The commands and manual steps that check the criteria.
page.info.boundaries: Rules for this ticket only: always do, ask first, never do.
page.info.correct_the_priors: The obvious but wrong way in this place of the code, and the right one.
page.info.where_to_look: The files and lines the planner checked, where the work starts.
page.info.out_of_scope: What this ticket deliberately leaves out.
page.info.why: The feature's decisions this ticket follows, and the research behind them.
page.info.dependencies: Tickets that must be done first, with their state now.
page.info.status: What is being done now, or what to take next, and how many tickets are in each state.
page.info.level: How complete this feature is meant to be, from 1 (the minimum) to 5, and what is put off.
page.info.decisions: The feature's choices, each with its reason; tickets point to them as D1, D2...
page.info.contract: The exact formats the parts of the feature agree on.
page.info.terms: Words of this feature; underlined ones on the page show their meaning.
